name: alarm-test-framework
description: Automated tests for Nudge (alarm-configurator), kept apart from the application they exercise.

scripts.test: npm run test:parallel && npm run test:serial
scripts.test:browsers: playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --grep-invert @serial && playwright test --project=firefox --workers=1 --grep-invert @serial && playwright test --project=webkit --workers=1 --grep-invert @serial
scripts.test:parallel: npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
